title: What If You Stood on Neptune's Moon Triton?

scenes.text: What if you stood on Neptune's moon Triton? It orbits the wrong way.
Voyager 2 measured minus 235 Celsius there, colder than any other object measured in the solar system.
Triton is 2,700 kilometers wide, with air about seventy thousand times thinner than Earth's.
Voyager 2 saw geysers erupting there, shooting nitrogen gas and dark dust several kilometers up.
Triton circles Neptune backwards, the only large moon to do so, and may have been captured billions of years ago.
A frozen world with active geysers. Thin clouds of nitrogen ice may drift a few kilometers overhead.
